tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Combinational Logic Systems

questions.question: Q: What logic gates does a half adder use?
questions.correctAnswer: An XOR gate for the Sum (A ⊕ B) and an AND gate for the Carry (A · B).
questions.explanation: Answer: An XOR gate for the Sum (A ⊕ B) and an AND gate for the Carry (A · B).

questions.question: Q: How many select lines does an 8-to-1 multiplexer need?
Q: Write the Boolean expressions for a full adder.
questions.correctAnswer: Sum = A ⊕ B ⊕ C_in; Carry-out = A·B + C_in·(A ⊕ B).
questions.explanation: Answer: Sum = A ⊕ B ⊕ C_in; Carry-out = A·B + C_in·(A ⊕ B).
